top_signals.title: Soaring Oil Freight Is Becoming a Risk to Fuel Supply
top_signals.summary: Shipping costs are eroding refineries’ margins, raising the prospect of run cuts that would further tighten the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Can crypto users trust the supply chain behind hardware wallets?
top_signals.summary: Ledger hardware wallet implants have renewed scrutiny of the middlemen handling devices before they reach buyers, even through authorized sellers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Breaking Down Bank of America’s Third-Quarter Earnings
top_signals.summary: Bank of America’s stock and fixed-income traders missed estimates in the third quarter, with bond-trading revenue falling 17% and equity trading down 10%. Chris Marinac, director of research at Brean Capital, examines the results on “Bloomberg Surveillance.”   (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Evernorth taps Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo to put $648 million XRP treasury to work
top_signals.summary: Evernorth said it is planning a phased move into XRP lending and yield strategies following its Nasdaq debut.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
